retention_policy: Preserve manifests, configs, runtime XML, logs, CSV/JSON/Markdown reports, PNGs, F32 diagnostics, and small protocol output/axis files. Omit only reconstructible .bin/.npy arrays larger than 1 MiB.
reconstruction_identity: Source and case manifests are retained; generated arrays are reproducible from the recorded seed/config and source identities.
post_archive_text_normalization: CSV CRLF line endings and text-log trailing padding were normalized after byte-for-byte archival verification; field values and non-whitespace content were unchanged.
